headline: Team competitor sheet merged
detail: Programmes we did not hold were added from the Power BI competitor sheet; only blank fields were filled on programmes we already had. 60 duplicate cohort rows and 9 Coursera/edX rows dropped.

headline: 5 ISB programmes confirmed live and added
detail: Chief Strategy Officer Programme, General Management Programme, ISB-NUS Global Advanced Management Programme, Business Strategy (ISB Online), EY-ISB Board Effectiveness for Women.

headline: Peer set widened to 19
detail: Added IIM Indore, SP Jain, HEC Paris, Kellogg, Stanford and four platforms (Emeritus, Imarticus, Jaro, TimesPro). Platform listings carrying a school's brand now count under that school.

headline: ISB product workbook checked against the catalogue
detail: Four ISB Online programmes were missing and are now added (fees still to be captured). Leadership Essentials (ISB Online) and Essentials of Leadership (campus) are now kept as separate products. Fees on the live site were kept where the workbook's Open Portfolio tab shows older, lower figures.

headline: Peer new-launch register added: 68 launches in the last 12 months
detail: Hand-verified register from the Product Team (26 Oct 2025 to 26 Oct 2026): Wharton 6, INSEAD 6, LBS 4, IMD 7, IIM-A 3, IIM-B 14, IIM-C 8, IIM-K 17, IIM-L 3, HBS 0. 31 are probable (school marks them new, no announcement date). 21 more checked and not counted.

headline: The dashboard is now a monthly brief
detail: Opens on what changed and what it means for ISB, with a page per topic, a programme-idea test, ISB's price position against its closest peers, and a timeline of peer launches.

headline: Search is now the home page
detail: Search any programme by topic, role, school or keyword; programmes other schools launched in the last year carry a New launch tag. Demand is described in words, and each call has its own colour.

headline: Programme names now open the programme's own page
detail: Each name links to its landing page where one exists, else its page in the school's catalogue, else its brochure; the programme page lists all three. 1,287 of 1,408 programmes now link to a page of their own, up from 1,062: links came from the Product Team's own files and the schools' catalogues and calendars, and each was opened on 29 Oct. Home pages, shared calendars and page titles held as links were replaced.

headline: 190 missing fees filled
detail: Programmes without a fee fell from 283 to 93. Fees were read off the schools' live pages on 29 Oct (IIM-B 66, Wharton 55, INSEAD 22, LBS 16, IIM-C 13, IMD 6, HBS 5 and others), plus 6 from the team's benchmarking files that are marked as not yet re-checked. Five programmes whose pages are gone are noted, not priced.

headline: ISB fees checked against ISB's live pages
detail: All direct ISB fees matched. Cybersecurity for Leaders was held as ₹14,900 and is ₹1,49,900. Management Essentials, Business Technology & Innovation with AI and Fintech Innovations now forward to other ISB pages, and General Management Programme forwards to AGMP: check whether they are still sold.

headline: Second pass on links and fees
detail: 1,324 of 1,408 programme names now open a page of their own (from 1,287) and 71 programmes lack a fee (from 93). New: IIM Indore's own programme pages, IIM-L and IIM-K brochures, partner pages for IIM-L long programmes, IIM-A online course fees, Wharton Online fees and IIM-K brochure fees. Course-aggregator listings are no longer used as programme links. Most programmes still unlinked are short IIM-L and IIM-K courses that no longer appear on the schools' calendars.
